verdict.rationale: The evidence documents reusable Templates for new Objects and mentions calendar blocks and Channels for journals. Nothing shows Anytype automatically creating a daily note for each day, applying a template to it, or making it the default landing place. Templates alone are an adjacent building block, not the automatic daily-note capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I get an automatic daily note for each day, pre-filled from a template, as the default landing place for journaling and capture
